estimand: Mean across distinct heldout problems of each problem's mean across its source components. Test-pass rates first average the tests within each source; source-weighted descriptive rates are also reported.

generation_policy.input_tokenization: rendered chat template; add_special_tokens=False; no truncation
generation_policy.primary_task_policy: lexicographically first task_id per source; sorted source order
generation_policy.prompt_policy: pinned PBPF public task prompts; Gemma system content folded into user
